title: Install R for Mac
text:
Check macOS version


Click the Apple menu in the top-left corner of your screen.



The Apple menu, expanded


Choose About This Mac.



The About This Mac option highlighted


Your version number appears under the macOS name.



Version number shown as macOS Sequoia 15.7.7






Download R based on your macOS version

Go to the R for macOS Installation site




R for macOS site



Determine the appropriate version of R


Which installer to download







Chip
macOS
Download




M1, M2, M3, M4
14 or later
the arm64 file


M1, M2, M3, M4
13 or earlier
update macOS first, then the arm64 file


Intel
11 or later
the x86_64 file









Can’t update macOS?





If you cannot update macOS, you can download the x86_64 file instead.




Click on the appropriate version, and the download will start automatically



Install R


Open Finder



The Apple menu, expanded


Open Downloads folder



The About This Mac option highlighted


Click on the package, and follow the guide



Version number shown as macOS Sequoia 15.7.7


When it’s complete, you’ll get a popup asking if you want to move it to trash. You can safely do this, it does not affect anything.



Version number shown as macOS Sequoia 15.7.7

title: Install R for Windows
text: Go to the R for Windows Installation site and click Download R for Windows. You must be running Windows 10 or higher.

title: Setup R
text: R and RStudio are different things and need to be installed separately.
